scope: Conceptual 3D close-up, not a telescope image or global PIC reconstruction

geometry.field: Analytic near-zone dipole: r=L sin^2(theta), rigidly rotated
geometry.polar_guides: Local nominal last-open dipole surface, r=R_LC sin^2(theta); no global openness solution
geometry.field_projection: Euclidean orthographic; not lensed field lines
geometry.line_sampling: Representative, not a magnetic flux density or plasma density map

beams.role: Illustrative emission-direction envelopes; not optical intensity, photon paths or material jets

surface.surface_assumption: Uniform normal-B atmosphere column; no surface temperature or field map
surface.geodesics: Direct outward Schwarzschild integrals with local SR Doppler and aberration
surface.phase_scope: Uniform surface has no temperature pattern; common GR-vs-flat outer propagation offset is not an aligned pulse prediction

display.tone_map: Fixed per-channel x/(1+x), then sRGB; compresses color toward white at high exposure

time: One 89.371ms stellar rotation displayed in 8 seconds; smooth periodic virtual-camera azimuth; repeated four times

export.rate_control: quality-targeted VBR with a VBV cap; CRF is not a platform requirement
export.color_conversion: sRGB RGB to Rec.709 limited-range YCbCr via zscale; pixels transformed before tagging
export.conversion_reference: display-referred: sRGB EOTF to linear light, then inverse BT.1886 (gamma 2.4) for Rec.709 display encoding
export.instagram_processing: Instagram generates its own delivery encodings; playback quality is not guaranteed by local export
